item.title: A Complete Group
item.description: (Requesting Greenlights) Selflessness can only go so far.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: A total of 49 tombs(and one vacant tomb) located underground. The bodies belonged to a group of reality benders who could 'bless' (call it what you will) chosen areas and prevent anyone within those areas from ever getting injured or killed. As of now,their corpses now 'curse' people within 20 meters of them. It was something not even they knew the reason for.

Central Narrative: The story will begin with the only known survivor of the group being discovered and interviewed in the former headquarters of the group. The survivor explains that over 23 years,they have researched and logged all areas affected by their 'blessings' in order to see where the best places to bless would be.

He further explains that the reason they have all passed away was due to the leader.(Who he refers to as "The Willow") Her death caused a chain reaction upon all the members of the group to perish,leaving only the unnamed survivor to bury them.

Hook: If you enjoy stories about the history of abandoned places,this could definitely intrigue you if I do it right. In the end,its a simple story about the past of a group of people.

Additional Notes:
•The article will include the logs and research created by their group
•In the article,the survivor will state that his curse was the inability to leave the Headquarters and the tombs.He states that "the others were not so lucky."

•If there is anything that seems off,please tell me.

item.title: The innate nature of things.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: SCP is an Extradimensional space (hereafter referred to as ES). ES exists as a parallel dimension to our own. ES is filled with esoteric machines that continuously enforce the physical logical and thaumaturgic laws of reality.

Central Narrative: foundation discovers common abstract mechanism enabling magic. Through prodding it manage to open a door to ES. Finds machines and fucks with them discovering that they sustain the laws of the universe. ES has a layered structure and foundation goes deeper uncovering larger machines responsible for more significant laws. Security is tight and progress becomes harder as they get further in. As the foundation make progress, they learn that our universe is built of the foundation of one that came before. Nothing about this prior universe will ever make sense to us because it does not use any of the laws we use. The old universe ended because of a great machine that destroyed it while building another. The first great reveal is that said machine is the SCP.

The foundation find that some of the machines seem to have no effect on enforcing universal laws. A brave researcher fucks with one without permission and causes it to output a huge mass of metal. Analysis of this metal reveals some haphazard data encoded within. Foundation works out that the machine is trying to deliver a message. estimates that as much as 70% of the machine is dedicated to nothing more than composing and outputting a message. They integrate mechanical typewriters into parts of the machine and try and teach it English. After a very long time they get something coherent. The message simply reads.

“this is our gift to you.”

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Every law we know of both physical, logical and thaumaturgical is not innate and is instead enforced upon reality by a machine that you can physically touch. Where did the machines come from and what would happen if they were switched off?

Additional Notes:

I’m not 100% sure about all of the narrative beats here but this is the fundamental idea that I want to write. There are some fun bits that could be thrown in like logs from the foundation testing on the machines. More about the machine’s relationship with the forces of thaumaturgy could be explored. Also perhaps a GOI finds out about the machine and the foundation have to find a way to fortify it.

Could have some machines be found damaged. Suggests that others have been here and asks questions about what laws are not working the way they should. Could also have machines enforcing laws that the foundation where not aware of, creating even more intrigue.

I’d like to find a way of exploring the cosmic horror of what came before. My idea is that the previous universe was so awful that beings in that universe built the machine to create a better one, even though they could never live in it.

item.title: Lightspeed shoes
item.content:encoded:
A pair of brand-name running shoes which exponentially accelerate its wearer's speed based on the length of their stride, with strides 45 centimeters or longer plateauing at 99.9% c, due to the fact that no object with matter can achieve light speed.

Understandably, following the laws of physics, this would mean anyone wearing these shoes and attempting to walk would be sent flying at unimaginable speeds while likely destroying any object in their path while also igniting themselves and a good deal of their surroundings from the massive friction.

also, for some clarification, while I stated "strides" I would like to clarify that it applies to general movement including lifting the foot, kicking, etcetera, but it felt necessary to give some sort of measurement to reference from

item.title: 500 grains of people (seeking greenlights)
item.description: Basically 500 people from the future got turned into grains of sand
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Drama/Emotional

Elevator Pitch: SCP-X is the collective term for 500 sapient grains of sand, which all spontaneously appeared in Memphis Tennessee. They don't need to eat or drink, but they do sleep. They move around by sliding around, via anomalous means. They can all talk, but don't have any mouths, or facial features. They're all as audible as normal human beings, and are able to be killed easily, such as by stomping, throwing, etc.

+ Central Narrative
- Hide

The Foundation first acquires SCP-X when reports of screams in Memphis Tennessee, coming from nowhere start coming in. The Foundation investigates, and soon find the source, approximately 500 grains of sand. They take them to a site, and get the instances to pick one grain to explain what's going on.

The grain explains that they're from the year 2025, and during that year, several ginormous extraterrestrial space crafts landed on earth, and started killing every human they could find. Not animals, they left horses, dogs, everything else alone. They didn't offer surrender to the humans either.

When cities were clear of humans, the aliens started moving in to the houses, and started taking on the humans lives. Except they lacked all the problems that humans had. There weren't wars between them, they were eco friendly, using resources such as solar panels and energy supplies they had brought to earth from their ships. (The grain of sand knows this because he used to be a part of a group of humans who snuck into cities and tried to reclaim them.)

The aliens also seemed to have highly advanced technology, such as weapons that could freeze people in place, and even time machines. Eventually, almost the entire human population was wiped out. And soon the aliens began hording the last humans into chamber, where they were either vaporized, or transformed into other entities, such as animals, or plants, and even furniture. The grain of sand (who was a human at the time) was horded into a large chamber with around 500 other people. The SCP-X instance realized that the aliens operating the machine appeared to be panicking, and the machine malfunctioned, turning the 500 people into grains of sand instead of animals or furniture. It then started a countdown, and apparently went into a kind of "time travel mode", and sent them into the past.

The grains of sand all show signs of traumatization, reasonably. The file is then updated in February of 2025, stating that several ginormous extraterrestrial space crafts appeared out of a wormhole in the Earths solar system. Using information gathered from the SCP-X instances, the Foundation neutralizes the threat.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I think the attention grabber here is the end of the world vibe the story brings about, and how there were so little survivors.

Additional Notes: This is a little idea I came up with, let me know what you think of it, I'm open to all criticism and am looking to improve!

item.title: No Happy Endings
item.description: Can a princess defeat her evil godmother and find love as a record player? No.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article,

Genre: Fantasy, musical, emotional

Page Layout (Optional): Normal Article

Elevator Pitch: - A small, portable phonograph made in 1950's which will play music whenever the stylus is placed over the turntable, irregardless of weather a record is there. The music played will resemble that of 1920's musical theatre unless a record is put in, in which case it will play the normal record.

- A large number of small woodland animals closely but not exactly matching those from northern Europe will spontaneously manifest in the areas surrounding the phonograph, and move onto the structure. When the record stops, they will disappear.

- The stylus of the phonograph moves up and down when no record is present, which can be decoded through binary into communications. These messages will repeat until a return message is sent by manually moving the stylus in the code.

Central Narrative: - Object is discovered after a 'diplomat of West Trancindentalia' is arrested and his possesions searched through.

- Foundation contains the object and soon realises the code and begins communicating with the object. The object says that her 'wicked godmother Annabelle' tried as hard as she could to get her out, and must have parylised and kidnapped her. She says she can't see anything and is confused. The foundation agents tell her that she has been turned into a phonograph. This prompts her to play a song called 'I used to be a princess, now I'm a record player!'.

-In further communications, she says '[she] needs to find a prince and defeat the wicked godmother Annabelle'. The foundation says she can't, but the foundation agents will attempt to track her. She gives some nonsense instructions on how to find them, so the foundation tells her they usurped the throne and ushered in a new age of prosperity for 'West Trancindentalia'. The foundation basically thinks they have all they need to know, so they throw it into a locker and take it out once a week under an ethics committee mandate. The final addendum is a transcript of a song it sung called 'Locked in a Locker, Ain't that a shocker!'

Hook/Attention-Grabber: An ethics committee mandate showing the updated containment procedures and the original.

Additional Notes: The princess was turned into a phonograph because it was easy to smuggle across the border and into Australia.

item.title: A Actual "Pea" Shooter
item.description: An newbie joins GAW. Newbie creates something to get the gratification of his peers, doesn't go well as he hoped.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Comedy

Elevator Pitch: Guy who recently joined GAW creates an anomaly for his peers for gratification, he doesn't get it and he chastised for the anomaly.

Central Narrative: A new user joins GAW and is excited about the prospect so much he creates an anomaly get laughs and gratification from his peers. The anomaly is an amalgamation of different plant parts stitched together into the rough shape of an gun.

A vine with the back end of it curved into the spiral is the stock, a leaf clover is the trigger, the head of a Venus fly trap acts as placing ammo, a tree branch is the handguard, and a rose acts as the muzzle.

There is a specialized part that is near the Venus head, an enlarged mutated pea pod. Whenever water is poured into the mouth of the Venus head, the pod undergoes production of enlarged peas in the sack. The juices in the sack freeze the peas and they are pushed up into the chamber. Methane gases produced by manure inside the chamber ignite and propel the peas through the flower. These peas can cause damage similar to an actual bullet.

The newbie made this as an play on the word "Peashooter" as a joke and thought he would get a laugh from the users of GAW. Instead, they find it to be confusing, cringey, and in poor tastes. One user mentions that since it has to potential to hurt people, it counts as a lethal weapon, which goes against their rules. The Newbie profusely apologizes and promises to do better next time. The Foundation found this scp in the trash bin by an internet café.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I structured the scp this way to showcase another side of GAW, for anomalies that don't hit the mark of their liking. The whole "meat" of the article is a chat log recovered shortly after the Foundation discovers the SCP.

Additional Notes: Like I mentioned I don't plan on this scp being deep lore-wise, just want to show another aspect of GAW. What I want to know if this concept work fine as it is or if there are changes and fine-tuning that needs to be made.

item.title: The Shield that Redirects its Damage
item.description: First attempt at an SCP
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: A viking shield that when held by a living person will cause a blue energy field to cover it. The energy field can redirect any damage that is inflicted upon it right back at the attacker (Examples: Shooting it with a gun will result in bullet wounds appearing in you or slashing at it with a sharp weapon will give you stab wounds and cuts). However, it does have its limits.

Central Narrative: The shield was discovered in Norway in a viking ship burial by some archaeologists. The SCP came to the foundation's attention when reports of a cursed and powerful shield erupted upon its discovery so an investigation was initiated and the SCP was recovered. Tests and experiments were conducted to understand how it works which usually consisted of D-Class personnel and weaponized machinery attacking it.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: It is unknown where the shield gained its anomalous ability and who the creator/original wielder was. There is also little information on how the SCP generates its blue energy field though it is possible that there is some sort of mystical or magical force surrounding it. The shield could provide potential use to the foundation, but if fallen into the wrong hands it could lead to many problems.

Additional Notes: This is one of the first ideas I came up with and so far I'm not sure if there are any other SCPs that have a similar ability or concept, though I could be wrong.

item.title: SCP-5632 Idea: An Unorthodox Method Of Eternal Damnation
item.description: SCP Idea
item.content:encoded:
Hi. So, I have an idea for an SCP, obviously. That idea is as follows:

Temporal "loop" anomaly located in Germany, concerning an American strike team attacking a German outpost (5632-3). SCP-5632-1 is a member of the strike team (5632-2) and is the only member of 5632 still self-aware. The loop always ends with 5632-1's termination, at which point all entities involved in the loop slow to a stop, then reverse. SCP-5632-1 can approach Foundation Personnel, at which point entities in the loop will behave in a confused and agitated manner. Consequently, interviews can be performed with the subject, however it will always be terminated at the end of the usual duration of the loop. SCP-5632-1 is under severe mental distress. Also, 5632-1 cannot communicate verbally (excluding simple sounds), due to the lack of a tongue. It instead communicates via ASL or Morse code.

I'd like feedback on this please. I have a draft in progress, just in case.

item.description: [thread locked; duplicate]

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: History

Elevator Pitch: A creature/machine is found in an abandoned Obskurakorps laboratory and able to open up to other dimensions with a sinister past and purpose. Mostly focuses on mythology and history along with the central premise.

Central Narrative: The story is mostly told through historical documentation of an old Foundation site created post WWII. A former Obskurakorps base holding a part flesh and part mechanical entity that changes a area near it to that of another dimension. The Foundation spends years exploring these dimensions as the entity opens them though is never able to control the entity or understand how it works. It is revealed in an interview log with a captured scientist that the machine is searching for the Norse worlds of myth. Some it has found and others it continues to search for all while the potential threat of a hidden cell of the GOI remains at large.

Hook/Attention Grabber: The unknown factors that remain hidden and indecipherable all the while presenting a new threat to the foundation. The mystery that surrounds the site and the new worlds potentially within the Foundations grasp as well as the new twist it adds to a current GOI.

Additional Notes: I’d appreciate any feedback on tips to progress my article through the sites greenlighting process as this is still pretty new to me and I’d like to get it right.

item.title: Anti-Solid Soldier
item.description: A humanoid that will destroy any solids it comes in contact with it
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights:Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: A fuchsia humanoid about 3 m high, which possesses unproportionally big metallic fists integrated in its body. These fists can punch at a speed of 5000 km/h applying 732.16 gigatons of force. By punching repeatedly, it is capable of destroying solid matter up to the atomical level with enough attacks.

If any type of solid mass comes in contact with the SCP, it will sense the matter and disintegrate it completely until it doesn't sense any more solid mass. If there's no contact with solid matter it will “deactivate” and enter into a fetal position, darkening its color.

This SCP is blind but sound waves will attract the creature. It has an audible range of 30kHz, higher than any human. However it will ignore any sound or contact coming from any other non-solid element.

It has a higher density than water despite the metallic fists and its size, because of this, it stays at the surface of a liquid environment. It is suggested that his body may be made from an extremely compressed gas.

Due to this nature, if it came in contact with the geosphere, it would completely destroy the Earth's mass, ending in an XK End of the World Scenario, which is why it is classified as Keter.

Show
Hide

Central Narrative: In the North Sea of Norway, there have been instances of disappearing boats. Once, a marine returned and described a humanoid rock which obliterated their whole navy by punching.
Once the government of Norway gave permission, the foundation inspected the SCP, causing many losses upon arriving. Luckily, a team inspected the creature from further distance and proceeded various testings to understand the creature's nature.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The most interesting part of this SCP is the seemingly impossible way to contain it.
Any and all attempts of containing it, have failed, due to the lack of mobility of the creature or the impossible silent during the construction of a containment cell within it. The SCP must stay in a liquid body and never to be contained near the geosphere.

Additional Notes: This is my first SCP, and although i have a creative mind, i do not know if i could write this type of Files. That is why i ask for a critique for the concept.

item.title: (S)pecialized (C)ustodial (P)ersonnel [Tale]
item.description: If red herring COVERS up the messes MTF make, then who CLEANS up those messes.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: yes

Page Type: Tale

Elevator Pitch: on november 30th 2020, a breach occurred in the humanoid wing at site 59. “Hammer down” was sent in and at 0537 contained the entity, the resulting casualties were 28 foundation personnel. This however is not the story of “hammer down” it is the story of Alpha-45 “janitors” who have to clean up their mess and end up finding something strange.

Central Narrative: Seasoned alpha-45 squad leader Gilligan has a new member since in the last mission Zachary was taken out of commission due to spilling a barrel of acid onto himself. Henry seems confident about the job being a sanitation specialist in the military. soon finding he has his work cut out for him upon seeing the gruesome scenes within the wing.

Continued 
hope you are having a good day

Learning about the foundation and the reality of working there, having to do tasks such as collecting bodies and using a scanner to DNA identify their limbs to make sure all confirmed deaths are accounted for and throwing any loose “Scraps” of flesh and organs into a barrel of acid gil calls the “Stew.”

Gilligan is completely numb to the work he does having been a member of this MTF for 15 years and being a crime scene sanitation specialist for some time before that. Since the foundation doesn’t disclose the info on what caused the mess he likes to play a game he calls “CSI Miami” where he pretends to be an investigator, deducing the cause of death and what could have done it.

After many mop buckets and bottles of bleach they are nearly done when all the bodies have been accounted for and every limb is paired with them. However Henry finds a loose arm under a vending machine that puzzles the two, whose arm is it? Only one way to find out..


Hook/Attention-Grabber: A team of janitors are tasked with cleaning up the messes that other MTF cause all the time without consideration.

Additional Notes: Going for a more light hearted tone with the pair in no danger just the amusing interactions they can have in cleaning and seeing the foundation for the first time in its rawest form also going to throw a bit of mysteries in the end.

item.title: Extraterrestrial Artificial Intelligence
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlight: Yes

Page Type: A little confused on this one because I feel it would be an SCP but it is very story driven, I feel most of it would be Addendums (recordings) of conversation with it.

Genre: Mystery

Page Layout: As I mentioned in the Page Type, I feel a lot of it will revolve around addendums.

Elevator Pitch:

  • An alien artificial intelligence that is billions of years old and was sent to Earth.
  • Large enough to be picked up by satellite imagery and certain telescopes.
  • In the shape of a hand, with a large "Oculus" in the center of the palm.

Central Narrative: The Hand claims it is a watcher of Earth, sent by an ancient civilization before it went extinct. Over the billions of years of travelling to Earth, the Hand began to develop feelings and thought processes, which it relates to humanity's empathy, sympathy, loneliness, and wish for death. It claims the end of humanity is coming rather soon, and until then it lays dormant in the Solar System waiting to make a move. The oculus is slightly opened. Behind the Oculus is a clock which Agents would give it the name, "Midnight Clock" being a reference to the doomsday clock, which is minutes from midnight.

Hook/Attention Grabber: I just think having something be extraterrestrial and an artificial intelligence is interesting. I've done my research on SCPs and anything either extraterrestrial or artificial intelligence, and decided to mash them together.

Additional Notes: Give your feedback.

This device is a small square object which, when touched, unfolds into a pane of unnaturally tough glass about the size of a piece of paper. The pane displays a text on its surface in cuneiform, while also presenting the option to translate the text into thousands of languages including multiple extinct and anomalous ones. In English, the text complains that the recipient had sold low-quality copper to the author, who needed durable copper to repair their time machine and return to their home year of █████ ███. The author demands compensation and higher-quality copper.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: A futuristic text in an ancient ruin? Hmm, what could the subject matter be?

item.title: Woodbones
item.description: A creature seeking out the frail and weak.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: History

Page Layout: The layout of the article will mainly consist of Naim's interview with an SCP researcher and end with an autopsy of Naim after his death.

Elevator Pitch: SCP-XXXX is a long, skinny branch-like creature with a conscious. It is able to bend, break, and mend its body to create shapes. SCP-XXXX was first recorded hiding among trees in a forest outside the town of Ptichar, Bulgaria. The creature lurks in forests and attempts of make contact with children aged 6-12 years old. SCP-XXXX will approach selected targets and reach out one of it's appendages. If the child refuses contact, SCP-XXXX moves on to a new target. If the target "accepts SCP-XXXX's invitation", SCP-XXXX will begin to fold upon itself and burrow its thin body into the skin of the target. Once inside, SCP-XXXX begins to replace the spinal chord and bones of the target.

Central Narrative: The story will follow Naim Suleymanoglu, a Bulgarian weightlifter, who was affected by SCP-XXXX. Naim will begin his story in the woods hunting with his father when he was approached by SCP-XXXX at age 10. Naim accepts and SCP-XXXX begins its process. He will explain how he no longer has control of his body, but instead is instead in subconscious conversation with SCP-XXXX constantly. Naim will explain he is constantly bullied in school for his weak and small frame until SCP-XXXX gave Naim incredible strength and power as the matter composing SCP-XXXX (though looks like wood) is of unknown composition and shows immense, unbreakable strength. Naim will tell his story of first resenting SCP-XXXX but eventually becoming fond and reliant on it. It will then follow how Naim won countless Gold medals and weightlifting titles in the Olympics.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Much of the article will be Naim explaining conversations with SCP-XXXX while it was inside of him. He will explain its goals and thoughts and why it does what it does in interviews with SCP researchers while it is still inside of him.

Additional Notes: Naim Suleymanoglu is a real man who stood at 4' 11'' weighing 137 lbs who managed, despite his size, to break many world records in weight lifting. There are specifics I have planned out for his story that I couldn't fit into the word count so please ask if any interest you!

item.title: Reanimating Elephant Graveyards

item.content:encoded:

Page Layout (Optional): Mostly the usual shtick, might include interview logs and/or discovery logs. This part isn't fleshed out yet and can still change a lot.

Elevator Pitch: All elephant graveyards are anomalous, the skeletons in them inevitably coming to live every 40-70 years. The living dead results reassemble themselves in a humanoid shape and move in a specific direction for 15 minutes before then falling apart again and repeating the process 40-70 years later.
The place they are moving towards is an obscure part of Russia where other elephant skeletons have already been stacked up many meters high in an intricate shape.
There also may be a secondary effect to the living skeletons that causes people to hallucinate, blurring the details of the encounter.

Central Narrative: No concrete narrative but rather the idea that the public is aware of the elephant skeletons, considering them an urban legend. The foundation would then have to base its procedures on that fact and make sure the people believe the scp to be a hoax.
The event's age would also be explored as parallels are drawn between it and cave drawings or alleged cyclops encounters.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The main hook would be the vague knowledge that the public has of the scp, as well as the weirdness of the event itself. Similar ideas have been made into scps before but I believe that the specifics make my concept stand out among the others.

Additional Notes: The whole "humanoid elephant skeleton" idea is largely based on the theory that people used to mistake elephant skulls for those of cyclopes, creating that myth in the first place.
Specific numbers and values were mostly chosen to make the scp as annoying to contain as possible(a bit silly in hindsight).
I know that the idea still needs a good amount of polishing. I hope I can turn it into something sort of worthwhile in the end.

item.title: The Rube Effect
item.description: Woman evades death by a string of 'random' events that neutralizes immediate threats.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Drama/Emotional, Comedy

Page Layout: Test and incident logs to be included. I intend to cross refence other works, but would like to ask permission from other authors before I commit to that.

Elevator Pitch: Woman is infected with a "virus" of sorts that neutralizes nearby deadly threats with 'events' that work on a similar principle to the butterfly effect or a Rube Goldberg machine. It can manipulate any non-organic material to complete an event. The woman is incredulously unaware of her anomalous properties.

Central Narrative: The virus is contagious but this is unknown by the Foundation at the time of the article's writing. Its effects are efficient but subtle. The Subject was the child of two researchers who were killed in a containment breach. She's sent to live at the School for Children of Prominence. A boarding school/orphanage for children of Foundation personnel. She is notably idiotic and it amazes her teachers that she actually graduates. Once she starts working for the Foundation as a junior researcher, her peers are dumbfounded that despite lacking all common sense she has yet to die. This prompts an investigation and her eventual classification as an SCP. After the article is submitted for review the higher ups begin to doubt the judgement of the lead researcher and try to have the SCP declassified due to 'lack or sufficient anomalous evidence'. The lead researcher is shunned and dives into a depressed drunken stupor. It remains to be seen if the Foundation will continue the research and discover how to harness the power of this virus.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The virus isn't all powerful and it wont infect just anyone. It's host can still be injured and it will not prevent death due to biological means such as old age or venom. It is, however, very good at keeping its host alive. The Foundation would kill to have something like this for all of their field agents.

item.title: Two Dimensional Love
item.description: Sounds good on paper, doesn't it?
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror

Elevator Pitch:

  • A bloodstained kirigami paper doll 1.56 meters in length drawn on to resemble a female human in an anime style, wearing gothic "lolita" style attire. Edges of the paper are abnormally sharp and capable of inflicting wounds on contact far greater than the amount of pressure and composition of the fibers would allow for. Subject is inanimate but believed to be sentient.
  • Any male who enters the doll's line of "sight" has an approximate 3% chance of being imprinted on, upon which its effect manifests. Upon entering REM sleep, the victim has a 50% chance to enter a state similar to sleep paralysis, in which a vision of the doll will appear to them and gently caress them, leaving deep wounds. This process is painless but can still result in complications from blood loss or infection.
  • Any female (biological or transgender) the victim interacts with that is not of blood relation enters a similar state the next time they sleep in which they are executed in a manner similar to the Chinese Lingchi. This process is not painless.
  • If the victim has not expired after a period of seven days, they will progress to Stage 2 in which they have an approximate 12.5% chance of the doll attempting to copulate with them. This normally results in death by blood loss. Only one affected victim can exist at a time.

Central Narrative: Article proceeds normally, with an addendum regarding its recovery from the belongings of a deceased Japanese man implied to be its creator after his "suicide" in police custody. Several experiment logs are listed near the end with the Foundation using D-Class to determine how it works.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Final experiment log has the Foundation manage to keep a D-Class alive long enough to describe Stage 2 to them. He explains that the doll, which was silent before then, kept repeating a single phrase: "Mō kakkoīdesu ka?" (Japanese for "Are we cool yet?")

Genre (optional): Unsure

Page Layout (optional): Contains containment procedures, description, discovery, test logs, and maybe even a cross-link.

Elevator Pitch: A “living” carved wooden vulture that feeds on human corpses. It will get “hungry” after 24 hours, which is when it will start searching for corpses to feed on. If it hasn't eaten for 36 to 48 hours, it will enter a frenzy, which makes it exponentially stronger and more aggressive. In this state, it will eat people alive in order to satiate its “hunger.” In this state, it will even ignore any dead human meat and go straight for the nearest living human.

Central Narrative: What is speculated to be its first victim was a woodworker specializing in custom statues. It's believed that the vulture killed the victim as opposed to feasting on their corpse.

Ever since the first body was found, mutilated and dismembered, many more bodies soon popped up with similar disfigurements. This caused many problems for local law enforcement.

+ show block
– hide block

The Foundation stepped in when a video of the creature was brought into the hands of the police. What caught their eye was the unnatural material it seemed to be made out of.

The Foundation easily caught it with the scent of human flesh, but they did not fully understand its eating habits at the time, nor did they anticipate the consequences of the lack of understanding that they had. They tried to feed it animal carcasses. They were able to keep it for 2 days before it escaped in one of its “frenzy states” and ate a Class-D Personnel alive. It was soon recaptured and given human flesh to eat. It hasn't escaped, nor tried to escape since then.

Presently, the SCP sits in its containment cell, docile. It is given a pound of human flesh every 24 hours. It seems to be satiated.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The simple but unique appearance and description combined with the grotesque nature of its feeding.

Additional Notes: “How's The Foundation able to obtain the human flesh that they feed the SCP?”

The Foundation has struck a deal with a nearby city using one of their front companies, which allows them access to unwanted or unclaimed dead bodies. They also have access to the corpses of people who have donated their bodies to science.

I’d be willing to delete the “escaped and ate a person” part to make The Foundation not look like idiots.

If this ever gets greenlit I’d like to include a brief cross-link to SCP-3847 if possible.

item.title: SCP Concept: Life is short
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: A humanoid SCP that is given birth to by a randomly picked woman in labour across the world, however the SCP will only live for 24 hours and when it dies another woman gives birth to it. It varies gender between times.

Central Narrative: A woman is in a hospital, going through labour, and finally gives birth to her child. She's happy, but something feels off, the child doesn't scream and both her and the doctors are shocked and panicked, until the baby speaks to them and wiggles itself free. When on the ground, it introduces itself to them before being taken to a special room in the hospital. The child doesn't understand them and tries to leave the room before being studied by doctors, amongst them an undercover Field Agent from the Foundation. It soon explains itself to the team and it's able to escape from the hospital. After that it seeks new places to go, observe, study and learn. This SCP was then reported to the Foundation and later was observed and studied a few times by the Staff.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The most interesting thing about this anomaly is that the SCP can remember past life experiences, it can grow very intelligent and wise over years and aqquire knowledge for many things, even as a newborn, and it's believed that it's main purpose is to learn. The only limits it has is it's very short life and it's physical form when both very young and very old. The SCP is also never born with any defficiency. What's also interesting about this SCP is that currently it poses no threats to humans, however, as it grows more intelligent there is a possibility of it attempting to end humans.

Additional Notes: Some of the SCP's origin was discovered in a few interviews the Foundation had with it, it was discovered who it's first birth mother was and when it was created. The SCP also explains it's theory in how and why this anomaly was made and how it is yet to discover how to stop it. The anomaly is normally calm during interviews and shows no interest in harm of any life form, however it is triggered when reminded it has a short life cycle.

item.title: An Empty Cell (Looking for Greenlights)
item.description: An unused containment cell that makes people think there is an SCP in it, with a twist
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: Thought to be an unused containment cell that makes everyone who is aware of it think that an SCP is contained inside. This effect only works once per person and can be canceled out by simply stepping inside of SCP-XXXX. Although the affected individuals are all convinced that an SCP exists within SCP-XXXX, none of them can recall any details of the SCP. Due to its effects providing little to no risk to the safety of personnel working at the site, all new members transferred there are to be exposed to SCP-XXXX's effects and then going inside of SCP-XXXX, preventing the effect from repeating in that individual.

Show Narrative
Hide Narrative

Central Narrative: All of the above is stated in the description. Which is contained in an expandable block reading archived, and followed by "Further testing must be done to determine the nature of SCP-XXXX due to Incident-Placeholder." Incident-Placeholder details a newly transferred researcher being exposed to SCP-XXXX and following the procedures, stepping inside to remove its effects, however, this time he didn't come out. The stationed guards were sent inside to discover his corpse lying dead on the floor of SCP-XXXX. They also noted a note on the entrance of SCP-XXXX, noting, "I warned you, you didn't listen." This is followed by an addendum describing emails of a researcher requesting permission to conduct tests on SCP-XXXX, in order to prove her theory.

Her theory claims that there is in fact an SCP inside of SCP-XXXX, an SCP that has the ability to alter or block the formation of memories of anyone that is aware of it to not include it, and it is likely that whoever brought this SCP in has already lost all memories of how they did it, containing it in an anomalous cell just before all their memories were gone as a last-ditch effort in containing it.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I think people will be hooked and read further on to find out what the SCP is.

Additional Notes: The incident is not named placeholder, it is a placeholder for when I come up with a name. This isn't above 400 words, I just checked.

(I am now aware of 055, but I think the main thing is based around SCP-XXXX and not what it is containing, so it could still work.)

item.title: The Prince Charming
item.description: A Lost Prince with an unworldly handsomeness looking for his home until the SCP Foundation Found him
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlight: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Speech: SCP- XXXX is a young man that has an unnatural hair and eye color that changes depending on his mood, with a short height, an unnatural pale skin and mostly of all, has an unworldly charisma. He wears a crown and clothes of a prince like those in fairytales indicating that he's from another world or the era where royals exists (I'm still looking for what that era or time was called). SCP-XXXX shows no sign of aging and has an ungodly regenaration ability but most of all his presence makes people love him romantically despite their gender, but being expose to XXXX has significant effects on people, it has five stages from Fondness, Liking, Loving, Obsessation, and Madness. Research shows that the dead body of the people that surrounds XXXX turns to smoke which XXXX absorbs enhancing his regenerative ability and it also shows that he also gains the said person's abilities and memories though despite this the researchers observed that XXXX shows no knowledge of this ability of his.

+ show block
– hide block

Central Narrative: SCP-XXXX was found wandering around the forest of one of the facilities of the SCP Foundation with confusion and sadness written on his face and hair that keeps turning to yellow and blue. The personnels that was guarding the perimeter of the said facility, find it weird and interesting at the same time, and without hesitation quickly implemented an order to quickly capture him.

They quickly send out a team to capture him, though upon contact the agents stopped and examine XXXX intently. XXXX quickly introduced himself with a smile as Prince Jun, his hair and eye color turning in a bright yellow, the agents dropped their weapons, going on their knees and bows towards him.

Meanwhile, The researchers that was watching from the CCTV cameras find it odd and interesting, and continued to watch what would happen. And from the footage they saw that all of the agents are kissing XXXX hands before they quickly stand up and leads him towards the SCP Facility, but before they can reach the gates all the agents started to act weird, first it started by bickering, to arguing, but the last is the most unexpected as the agents out of nowhere started killing each other while XXXX just continue to walk towards the gates without batting an eye.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Research shows that XXXX's ability also affects other SCP but not as powerful as it is with people, the research confirmed that XXXX's ability to affect other SCP has only two stages, from Fondness to Liking. As further research goes the Foundation found that XXXX is helpful throughout his tests, he shows great cooperation and even helps the staff, and because of it the assigned researchers for XXXX tests had an idea of proposing to have him help the Foundation because of his abilities with a great promised of helping SCP-XXXX return to his home, in which XXXX quickly agreed, deeming him a Thaumeil Class.

Additional Notes: This is my first idea, I'm new in here and I want to know what you guys think about it, also I was suppose to make this guy a creepypasta but I changed my mind.
